## SimAsset / Test results
All imported runs · Execution status and human assessments are separate. **Local review**
Review imported runs, execution status, human assessments and measurements. This local dataset does not represent completion of the 50-asset evaluation. A completed execution is not a human pass verdict.
Preferences의 Interface theme에서 Light · D: Choose Light, Dark or System preference under Preferences → Interface theme.
에셋 이름의 종류 수입니다. 내용 해시가 다른 버전은 같은 이름으로 묶이: Distinct asset names. Versions with different content hashes share a name. This is not the completion rate for the 50 selected assets.
현재 유효한 사람 판정이 하나 이상 있는 실행 수입니다. 판정 항목이나: Runs with at least one current human assessment. Multiple criteria or reviewers on the same run count as one reviewed run.
실행 완료는 사람의 통과 판정이 아닙니다. 원본 상태는 하네스가 기록한: A completed execution is not a human pass verdict. Source statuses retain the original harness values.
현재 유효한 판정의 최근 50건입니다. 평가자·검토 항목·기준 버전을 구: Latest 50 current assessments, grouped by reviewer, criterion and rubric version. Test-fixture assessments are separate from team evaluations.
에셋별 실행 · 버전과 출처: Runs by asset · Versions and sources
같은 에셋 이름·내용 해시·검사·출처·상태를 묶습니다. 실행 수는 에셋: Grouped by asset name, content hash, test, source and status. Runs are not asset counts. Batch counts represent separate import namespaces.
전체 측정값 펼쳐보기 · 최대 1,000행: All measurements · Expand for up to 1,000 rows
측정값 · SI와 원본 항목: Measurements · SI values and source fields
수치와 단위를 함께 읽습니다. 미측정은 빈 값과 사유로 보존하며 0으로: Read values with their units. Missing measurements stay empty with a reason; they are not zero. Scroll horizontally for source text, seed, run ID and asset hash. Open the review app for full source files and assessment history. Field names retain their original form; values and units use SI. Values display up to 8 decimal places without changing stored precision.
